div.head: Af 9
div.ab: X. Gif hwa wif ofslea mid bearne, þonne þæt bearn in hyre sy, forgilde heo fullan gylde, ⁊ ðæt bearn be ðæs fædrencnosles were healfan gylde.
X. Gif mon wíf mid bearne ófslea, þonne þæt bearn in hire sie, forgielde ðone wifman fullan gielde, ⁊ þæt bearn be ðæs fædrencnosles were healfan gelde.
Si femina pregnans occidatur, dum puer in ea sit, soluatur ipsa pleno gildo, et partus dimidio gildo secundum weram patris.
{X} Gif mon wíf mid bearne ófslea þonne þæt bearn in hire sie, forgielde ðone wifman fullan gielde, ⁊ þæt bearn be ðæs fædrencnosles were healfan gelde.
If a woman bearing a child is slain when the child is in her, let [the slayer] pay full recompense for the woman, and compensate for the child by half the wergild [appropriate to] the father’s kin
If anyone slays a woman with child, while the child is in her womb, he shall pay the full wergeld for the child, [which shall be] in accordance with the wergeld of the father's kindred.
If a woman with child is slain when she is bearing the child, the woman is to be paid for with full payment, and the child at half payment according to the wergild of the father’s kin.
Wenn jemand ein schwangeres Weib erschlägt, während das Kind in ihr ist, vergelte er die Frau mit [ihrem] vollen [Wer]gelde, und das Kind mit halbem Entgelt gemäss dem Wergeld des Vatergeschlechts.
If someone slays a pregnant woman while the child is in her, let him pay for the woman with [her] full [wer]geld, and for the child with half payment according to the wergeld of the father’s kindred.

note.label: prompted by
note.quote: Some may have been prompted by the Mosaic laws excerpted in the preface. An obvious example is the decree on killing a pregnant woman (n. 89)
